title: Who was Michael Joseph Moore? DNA identifies former firefighter in 1968 murder of 16-year-old girl
summary_full: Police in Ontario have identified Michael Joseph Moore as the suspect in the 1968 murder of Jacqueline Dunleavy. Dunleavy, a 16-year-old girl, was found dead shortly after finishing her shift at a convenience store. Investigators used modern DNA testing techniques to link preserved evidence to Moore, who died in 2018. Despite this breakthrough, no criminal charges can be filed against him posthumously.
